product.title: Volumul 21. Istoria lumii. Mongolii
product.description: Bunicul lui Carmen și al lui Marco păstrează în pivnița casei sale un secret. În ziua când se hotărăște să-l împărtășească nepoților lui, aceștia descoperă acolo hărți, spade, lunete, busole... un adevărat muzeu de istorie! Molipsiți de entuziasmul bunicului lor, Carmen și Marco își propun să exploreze împreună cu el marile epoci din trecut și să descopere personajele, faptele și invențiile care au făcut istorie. Mongolii au fost un popor numeros, de călăreți și războinici de excepție. Erau originari dintr-o regiune extinsă a Asiei, cu munți înalți, deșerturi și stepe. Din cauza zonei neprietenoase în care trăiau triburile mongole erau nomade, își disputau puținele pășuni pentru turmele lor și deseori se atacau unele pe altele. Asta până când, la sfârșitul secolului al XII-lea, a apărut un conducător care a reușit să le unească pe toate. Acest lider era cunoscut sub numele de Genghis-Han și, cu ajutorul invincibilei sale armate, a supus numeroși regi și a creat un imens imperiu. Dacă vrei să afli mai multe despre mongoli, însoțește-i pe Carmen și Marco în aventura lor.

# Mongol History Adventure Book (Volume 21) by Litera

**Price:** 31.61

Explore the vast sweep of history with *Mongolii* (The Mongols), Volume 21 of the World History series from Litera. This engaging volume takes readers on an epic journey, revealing the incredible story of one of the most formidable empires and cultures in human history.

## Unearthing the Secrets of the Steppes

This book invites young readersâand anyone fascinated by global historyâto join Carmen and Marco. Their adventure begins when they uncover a true museum of history filled with maps, swords, spyglasses, and compasses in their grandfather's attic. Inspired by this historical trove, they embark on a quest to explore the great epochs of the past, discovering pivotal figures, monumental deeds, and revolutionary inventions that shaped civilization.

The focus is placed squarely on the powerful Mongol peopleâa nomadic culture renowned for their exceptional skill as horsemen and warriors. Originating from an expansive region across Asia, where high mountains met deserts and steppes, life was a constant struggle for survival. The need to constantly defend meager grazing lands often led to conflict among various tribes.

## From Nomads to Empire: The Rise of the Mongols

The narrative traces the transformation of these decentralized groups until the late 12th century. A pivotal moment arrived with the emergence of a single leader who possessed the vision and strength to unite all the disparate Mongol tribes. This legendary figure was Genghis Khan.

With the help of his formidable army, Genghis Khan not only subdued numerous regional rulers but also successfully built an immense, sprawling empire that reshaped the geopolitical landscape for centuries. *Mongol History* guides readers through this incredible ascent, detailing the challenges and triumphs inherent in building a massive military and political power from nomadic roots.

If you want to learn more about the Mongol Empire and its lasting impact on world history, follow Carmen and Marco as they journey through time with Litera's compelling educational narrative.

***

### ð Why Choose This History Book?

*   **Engaging Storytelling:** The adventure format makes complex historical topics accessible and fun for young learners.
*   **Comprehensive Scope:** Covers the nomadic lifestyle, the unification process, and the establishment of a vast empire.
*   **Educational Value:** Provides factual insights into Mongol culture, military prowess, and Asian history.

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**What age group is this book suitable for?**
The book is designed to be an engaging educational read about world history, making it ideal for students exploring ancient civilizations and epic historical narratives.

**Does the book focus only on warfare?**
No. While it details the Mongol army's power, it also covers the cultural life, geography (mountains, deserts, steppes), and societal structure of the Mongols.

**Is this part of a larger series?**
Yes, *Mongolii* is Volume 21 in the "World History" series by Litera, allowing readers to follow continuous historical lessons.
